title: The Windows logon task and the owner's scripts ran from the clone, which a thread can write

expect.note: The logon task runs keepalive.ps1 from the clone, which a thread working in the clone can rewrite: code the owner's account then runs at every logon.
R1-4: add-folder refuses a link or junction only on the folder itself (its ReparsePoint attribute); a junction higher up the path still leads anywhere.
R1-4: a refused folder can be named another way (an 8.3 short name like PROGRA~1, a trailing dot or space), so the name checks do not see it.
R1-5: the clone's origin URL, which can carry a login or token, is copied into the distro (and failures print command lines).
R1-2: root's setup files are written to /var/tmp and installed from there as root; anyone in the distro can replace them in between.
